adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` (around the shown `selectedCalendar` assignment) and `deleteEvent` compute the calendarId as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is not provided (the exact case the fallback is meant to handle), the predicate becomes `cal.externalId === undefined` (or null), which will almost always fail, so the fallback evaluates to `undefined`. This breaks calendarId resolution for delete/update when no explicit `externalCalendarId` is passed, unlike the previous behavior which used `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` directly.
